name: midas-memory
description: Local-first, source-traceable memory for Claude — no LLM at ingest, fully offline.
long_description: Midas gives Claude a persistent, **local** memory. Everything is stored on your own machine in a SQLite file, recall returns the **exact source text** (no LLM rewriting at ingest or query, so every memory is auditable), and capture/forget run with **no network calls** — your memories never leave your computer. Midas auto-scores what is worth keeping (facts, decisions, preferences, constraints, corrections) and drops chit-chat and duplicates, and it keeps the store bounded by forgetting low-value memories without an LLM. Install it and Claude starts remembering across sessions on its own via the recall → work → capture loop.

db_path.title: Memory database file
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite file Midas persists memories in (created if missing). Leave the default to keep memory across restarts.

embedder.title: Embedding backend
embedder.description: 'local' = offline semantic embeddings (BGE ONNX; one-time model download on first run). 'hashing' = pure-stdlib, zero download, lexical.

min_importance.title: Capture relevance floor (1-5)
min_importance.description: Auto-capture keeps only turns scoring at or above this. Higher = stricter (less is remembered). 2 keeps real facts/names/numbers and drops chit-chat.

max_records.title: Max stored memories (0 = unbounded)
max_records.description: When set above 0, the lowest-value memories are auto-forgotten (no LLM) once the store grows past this cap, so memory stays bounded.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a memory (fact, decision, preference, or conversation turn) for later recall.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Offer a turn to memory; Midas decides (no LLM) whether it is durable enough to keep.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve relevant memories with source-traceable score/provenance evidence.

tools.name: inspect_memory
tools.description: Inspect one stored memory by id without search, mutation, or embedding exposure.

tools.name: build_context
tools.description: Assemble a budgeted, prompt-ready context block from memory for a query.

tools.name: memory_policy
tools.description: Return the exact MCP-injected memory policy text and guard parameters.

tools.name: check_memory_use
tools.description: Decide whether recalled memory may justify a planning, answer, external, or destructive use.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a single memory by id (supersession chains are relinked, not orphaned).

tools.name: forget_matching
tools.description: Topic-level erasure: preview (dry run) then delete every memory matching a query, with a full audit.

tools.name: maintain
tools.description: Run a no-LLM retention pass (dedup / bound / prune) and return the deletion audit.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Memory stats: total count, breakdown by kind, and temporal-tier distribution.

prompts.name: memory_session
prompts.description: Switch Claude into Midas auto-memory mode for a session.
prompts.text: Start a Midas memory session for: ${arguments.goal}
